description: Course vocabulary counting aliases. These forms may appear in dialogue but do not earn a separate new-word credit. Keep the existing base at B1 or below; when that base is unavailable, use an existing family representative without promoting a higher-level verb.

distinct_entries.marketing: The activity of promoting products; not just the place called a market.
distinct_entries.engineering: A field of study or work; not a duplicate of a permitted base verb.
distinct_entries.setting: The place or circumstances of a story or event; not just the act of setting something.
distinct_entries.living: An income or way of life; retain the independent noun meaning.
distinct_entries.drunk: The adjective meaning intoxicated; retain this meaning separately from drink.
distinct_entries.talented: An adjective derived from the noun talent, not a verb inflection.
distinct_entries.indoors: An adverb, not a plural of the adjective indoor.
distinct_entries.outdoors: An adverb, not a plural of the adjective outdoor.
distinct_entries.IT: The acronym for information technology, not the pronoun it.
